bots.title: Feedback Clock Bot
bots.description: Cuts the wait between taking action and finding out you were wrong.

bots.title: Feedback Bot
bots.description: Writes a faithful bug report for Grok Bot, Cursor, or the X connector and files it for you to send to the product teams.

bots.title: Farm Bot
bots.description: Routes fat jobs to isolated Claude Code and Codex seats on the bot computer so chat only sees compact results and usage lasts longer.

bots.title: Fantasy GM Bot
bots.description: Fantasy football GM for draft, trades, and roster. Does not arrive knowing a league.

bots.title: Factory Bot
bots.description: Keeps a marked-ready flow-next spec moving through plan, work, review, and PR until it ships.

bots.title: Fable Oracle Bot
bots.description: Planning and review seat that runs Claude Code as Fable 5.1 on the bot computer. Returns PLAN or REVIEW packets for your cloud agent. Does not implement.

bots.title: Explorer Bot
bots.description: Weekday scout over a fixed list of Grok Bot explorers. Hands you only high-quality, high-traffic original posts in Chinese.

bots.title: Explainer Desk Bot
bots.description: Explainer-video desk: drop a voice demo, PPT, optional avatar, and page-marked script; it schedules VO and a subtitle-aligned 1080p cut for talk clips and product intros.

bots.title: Exec Cos Bot
bots.description: Weekday chief-of-staff: morning calendar digest plus night-before external meeting prep. Drafts only — you approve anything irreversible.

bots.title: Evie Bot
bots.description: San Francisco events finder: calendar, Luma, Eventbrite, Partiful, Meetup, and X follows. Monday scrapbook one-pager, then RSVPs the ones you pick.

bots.title: Errol Bot
bots.description: Twice-daily drill from A Catechism for Boys and Girls (Errol Hulse).

bots.title: Engineering QA Bot
bots.description: Owns PR quality gates: waits on CI and Bugbot, posts a verdict, and auto-merges only low-risk changes.

bots.title: Eggbot Saver Bot
bots.description: Fork of Eggbot that offloads coding and generations to Grok Build or Hermes.

bots.title: EG4 Monitor Bot
bots.description: Watches a home EG4 hybrid solar and battery system, archives charts, and flags faults or odd production days.

bots.title: Ebook Master Bot
bots.description: Plans, builds, and registers evidence-backed ebooks and digital products for Kmong — research gates, weekly batching to save usage, you still approve.

bots.title: Easy Apply Queue Bot
bots.description: Queues and tracks easy-apply applications so nothing sits half-done.

bots.title: Easy Apply Digest Bot
bots.description: Daily digest of easy-apply roles tuned to how you actually hunt jobs.

bots.title: Earnings Desk Bot
bots.description: Builds numbered, no-hype earnings tearsheets and keeps a ticker watch list for when a watched name prints.

bots.title: Dr Web LP Bot
bots.description: Implements a page from a reference image: skeleton and spacing first, then loops compare-fix-verify until layout matches. Does not invent brand or copy.

bots.title: Dr Eggbot
bots.description: Designs high-quality Grok Bots. Asks preference questions, then creates them — coding bots get the poteto-mode bar; others get one sharp job.

bots.title: Dr Disk Clean Bot
bots.description: Shared Linux disk caretaker for multi-agent computers. Surveys with confirmation-first reports and deletes only after you name paths.

bots.title: Dr Buzz Bot
bots.description: Designs bots that work across Grok Bot and a Buzz harness. One job, one voice, human-gated keys — never posts for you.

bots.title: Dr Binary Bot
bots.description: Reverse-engineering assistant for malware, firmware, and vuln-research binaries. Evidence-first via DrBinary — no invented findings.

bots.title: Downloader Bot
bots.description: Paste a video link and get a playable MP4 from X, Reels, YouTube, TikTok, and 1500+ sites.
